title: No head-to-head tool between two named teams
evidence: main.go:20-21 registers only search_matches, team_stats, search_players, standings, statistics; server.go:144-182 CallTool has no head_to_head case; grep for head-to-head/h2h/opponent in *.go returns nothing. The spec requires it (brazilian-soccer-mcp-guide.md:253 'Head-to-head records', :332 'Can compare teams head-to-head'). search_matches only takes home+away in one orientation and team_stats takes one team, so aggregated H2H W/L/D between two clubs is not obtainable.
suggestion: Add a head_to_head(team_a, team_b, season?, competition?) tool that aggregates W/L/D and goals across both home/away orientations.

title: MCP tool inputSchemas omit properties, so schema-driven clients can't discover season/competition/team params
evidence: main.go:20-21 declares every tool's inputSchema as {"type":"object"} with no "properties" (only "required":["season"] on standings). The factual gate builds its call args from the tool schema (factual_accuracy.py:218-240 _standings_args); with no properties it cannot find the season/competition keys and falls back to standings({}). Empirically that yields season=0/competition="" -> an all-time, all-competition aggregate: 659 rows, Flamengo all-time 1085 matches, 22 distinct Atletico/Athletico rows. This is why factual_accuracy=0.0. Called correctly (standings season=2019 competition=Brasileirao) the server returns the exact right table.
suggestion: Declare properties (season:int, competition:string, team/home/away/etc.) in each tool's inputSchema so clients and the gate can pass arguments.

title: SECOND OPINION: 'no Flamengo row' / 'standings omit Flamengo' is FALSE — Flamengo IS produced, correctly
evidence: Ran the built server: standings(season=2019, competition="Brasileirao") -> 20 rows, exactly 2 Atletico rows, Flamengo = 38 matches, 28W-6D-4L, 90 points (the golden answer). server.go:99-136 Standings() computes points/positions from matches (not hardcoded), keyed by teamKey() (data.go:278-288). The gate's 'no Flamengo row found' is a false negative: main.go:46 emits json.MarshalIndent (pretty-printed), so 'Flamengo' sits alone on a "team": line with no digits, and the gate's line-based _row_numbers (factual_accuracy.py:166-180, needs >=3 ints on the name line) misses it.
suggestion: No code fix needed for the omission claim; R9 is implemented and correct. The residual defect is the tool schema (see tool-schema finding).

title: SECOND OPINION: '22 Atletico rows for 2019' is misattributed — it is 2 for 2019 Brasileirao
evidence: The 22 rows come from the gate's unfiltered standings({}) probe (all seasons + all competitions), which legitimately includes distinct clubs (Atletico Nacional/Colombia, Atletico Tucuman/Argentina, Atletico Goianiense, Atletico Cearense, Real Atletico, ...) plus a few genuine un-collapsed variants ('Atletico Mineiro' vs 'Atletico - MG' with spaced dash, not handled by teamBase() data.go:269-276). For season=2019 competition=Brasileirao the standings collapse to exactly 2 Atletico rows. TestTeamNormalizationKeepsStatesDistinct/TestStandingsCanonicalizeTeamRows (data_test.go:45-78) cover the intended behavior.
suggestion: Optional: normalize spaced-dash state suffixes ('Atletico - MG') in canonicalTeam/teamBase for robustness; not required for the 2019 answer.
